r9b-001.gate_key: aux_verbs | A2.1 | mcq | Choose the correct short answer: 'Have you got a bike?' | Yes, I have.

item.q: Choose the correct short answer: 'Have you got a bike?'
item.why: A short answer to *Have you got …?* repeats *have / has* without *got*: *Yes, I have. No, she hasn't.* To *Do you have …?*: *Yes, I do.*
item.why_lv: Īsajā atbildē uz *Have you got* …? atkārto *have / has* bez *got*: *Yes, I have.* (nevis *Yes, I have got*.) Uz *Do you have* …?: *Yes, I do.*
